title: OpenVPN client configurations
whyItMatters: OpenVPN profiles can inline certificates and keys and name remote networks. They show which private networks this PC could reach.
source: OpenVPN GUI docs: per-user config directory C:/Users/<user>/OpenVPN/config - https://github.com/OpenVPN/openvpn-gui/blob/master/README.rst
notes: Per-user profiles only; the system-wide C:/Program Files/OpenVPN/config tree is not covered. .ovpn files, certificates and keys are never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy the profiles you still need to the machine you are moving to, and keep the VPN logins in a password manager.
cleanup.signOut: Ask the owner of each VPN server to revoke this device's certificate, or change the account password it used.
steps: Copy out the profiles you still need.
Ask the server owner to revoke this device if it used a certificate.
Delete the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Deletes the VPN profiles, including any certificates and keys stored inside them. The remote network keeps trusting anything not revoked there.
